money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR/Bank Guarantee of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata, payable at Kolkata; valid three months from technical bid opening; exemption not allowed; original EMD must reach the office by last date of bid submission. Estimated cost printed as 'Rs. 4,55 000.00/-'.

period.bid_validity: 180 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration of appropriate class in appropriate category (building civil work) with Central Govt department/undertaking/autonomous body or State Govt
Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two each >= 50%, or one >= 80%; supported by client certificates; value updated at 7% simple per annum
Similar works: gardening works at Central Govt/State Govt/other reputed private organization/NGO firm
Valid PAN card and GST registration
Notarized affidavit (2026) that bidder is not blacklisted or debarred by any Central/State government organization
Undertaking on letter pad that price bid is unconditional; signed Tender Acceptance Letter; other documents per Section VI
notes: Section I NIT only; no BOQ or plantation specification (number/species of trees not stated). Hindi text layer is missing/garbled, so page 2 was rendered to confirm the completion period (60 days) and other table values. Bid document download 27.07.2026 15:00 to 17.08.2026 15:00.
